proposition: Melvin-Koushki himself records that Bihbahani, Danishpazhuh, Zarrinkub and Corbin's R. Shaqq-i Qamar study each touched on Ibn Turka's lettrist or mystical-lettrist side before him, so his claim to be first is a claim about sustained analysis of the lettrist thought.

mediation.note: MK's own interpretation, offered in support of his thesis that Ibn Turka was an occult philosopher.
